name: hexo-pro-edgeone
description: Hexo-Pro 功能的纯 Web CMS：EdgeOne Pages 部署，GitHub API 管理内容，pure-admin UI，SQLite 持久化，腾讯云 COS 图床

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hexo-pro/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @hexo-pro/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @hexo-pro/api build:edge && pnpm --filter @hexo-pro/web build
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist dist-edge .turbo 2>/dev/null; echo cleaned
